claim: The coarse motorised xy stage is an element of the microscope body channel, on the body hub. The body's optical elements belong to the optical_path lock group while the motor stage belongs to the stage lock group, because the piezo rides on the motor stage. One channel therefore carries two lock groups, and a lock group is a property of an element rather than only of a channel.
validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument. What is confirmed here is the hardware arrangement and the group each element belongs to. What follows from it under one-channel-one-worker -- that stage moves serialise with port and filter changes, and that the lock a worker waits on is chosen per command rather than per channel -- is a design consequence, not a reading, and is not stamped as one. Falsified by the stage being moved off the body hub or the piezo being mounted elsewhere.
